nodes.text:
@bradledwith @outbreakupdates After I shared that here last night,  I saw a tweet that showed Human Metapneumovirus is currently off the charts in Vegas. 

It’s been reported over the last months that China’s hospitals had been overwhelmed by folks sick with HMPV.

nodes.author: bradledwith
nodes.text: @momoonla @outbreakupdates I’m pretty laid back when it comes to kids and being sick…I’ve had four and he is my youngest.  It was a brutal episode of respiratory coughing & shortness of breath and mix in body aches and fever and I was a little bit worried.

nodes.author: momoonla
nodes.text: @bradledwith @outbreakupdates Was he the only one that got sick?

nodes.author: bradledwith
nodes.text: @momoonla @outbreakupdates We all got sick but at different levels. His was definitely the worst
